_about: Bike lanes (engine/fetch_bikes.py, engine/bikes.py): SFMTA's Bike Network Linear Features (DataSF ygmz-vaxd). Each segment's California facility class (facility_t) puts it in a class: Class IV separated bikeways, Class II bike lanes, Class III bike routes (sharrows and signs), Class I off-street paths. Types not listed are left out and printed by the build.
name: streetname
